claim: Accidentally placed package with USPS label in FedEx drop box
summary: I mailed in a return and the company typically uses FedEx to ship, so I just assumed the return would be through FedEx as well. I placed the prepaid label on the package (apparently totally ignoring the USPS logo lol) and dropped it at my nearest FedEx drop box. So what happens now? Will it make it to the post office? Will FedEx mail it? I’ve read conflicting things online. TIA!
